meta.title: Kagi web search
meta.description: Search with Kagi using KAGI_API_KEY or a key saved privately in settings.

ui.description: Use Kagi for web search. API usage is billed separately by Kagi.
ui.hint: Uses KAGI_API_KEY from the computer running DSH first. Otherwise, enter a key to store it privately outside the settings file.
ui.environment: Using KAGI_API_KEY from the DSH host environment. No key entry is needed.
ui.configured: An API key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.
ui.missing: No API key is configured. Enter your Kagi API key to enable web search.
ui.loadError: Could not load settings. Close and reopen this section to try again.
ui.saved: API key saved. Kagi web search is ready.
ui.saveError: Could not confirm the save. Close and reopen this section to check the saved state before retrying.
ui.readOnly: Credential storage is read-only on this deployment.
